definitions.label: Play-volume proxy
definitions.description: Pass attempts + rush attempts; not a play-by-play count.

definitions.label: Passing yards / attempt
definitions.description: Net passing yards / pass attempts; source sack conventions apply.

definitions.label: Points / play proxy
definitions.description: All team points / play-volume proxy; includes non-offensive scoring.

definitions.label: Fourth-down conversion
definitions.description: Fourth-down conversions / attempts; zero attempts is missing, not zero.

source: SportsDataverse ESPN team box-score release; schedules supply final points. ESPN is the shared upstream source, not an independent corroboration.
